internal_gate_code.scope: Original retained package instructions; no physical flash or runtime sample.

paired_event_paths.operation: AND the pending byte with the complement of its paired mask byte; on selected bit3 set, set the same control bit before testing the software gate.
Same operation on a second pending/mask byte pair; shares gate, selected read and timer6.

selected_read.operation: Write selector72 to an internal window, then read the adjacent byte. Results1 or10 select timer6; other results take the other arm. The numeric result is not a qualified cable/orientation/mode label.
selected_read.inventory_limit: Literal MOV DPTR inventory only. Reads using INC DPTR are separately reviewed. Indirect access and hardware/host writers are not excluded.

software_gate.operation: The reviewed interrupt setup clears the gate. A subsequent selected pending/mask bit4 path performs register setup and sets the gate to1. Its live value and electrical event meaning are unknown.

internal_gate_code.important_context: Both event paths set the control bit before testing the gate. Timer6 is conditional; it is not the only writer or universal lifetime of that bit. This prevents treating the previously found timer as proof of a stuck bit or a complete reset sequence.
internal_gate_code.unresolved: The selected-read return is produced behind an internal register window; no software implementation, physical signal name or host-access alias has been established.

mode_code.scope: Code reads and branches, not captured input values.

main_loop.operation: Read internal byte2, mask81, and call7ace/c9fe when either selected bit is set.

separate_branches.operation: Selects a configuration-write branch; its false arm reaches the bit7 test.
Selects a separate configuration-write branch; false skips that block.

orientation_shaped_selection.operation: Chooses low-pair versus high-pair masks on two internal control bytes.

paired_input_gate.predicate: Byte0 bit2 and byte2 bit4 must both be set before a further sequence/status test.

mode_code.limit: Internal byte offsets are not independently qualified host I2C aliases. No current mode, register writer, port ownership, entry success or Windows intervention is established.

upstream_definitions.meaning: The Linux implementation writes these configuration bytes. They are not independent link-lock measurements, and this reference does not establish the ASUS runtime writer.

comparison.basis: Inference from the original code masks and independently pinned PS883x implementation.
comparison.finding: Six field positions and the orientation-dependent control selection are consistent with the internal bytes being the retimer connection-mode inputs. The USB4-shaped bit7 branch is now a specific code path to follow.
comparison.limits: Matching field positions is not independent proof of a host-I2C alias, ASUS bus ownership or the value during DEG2 attachment. No write test is qualified.

research_resources.status: Official model page opened and listing verified; PDF board pages and fitted-board identity still require inspection. It is not a verified electrical schematic. Third-party paid boardview search labels were not accepted as board identification.
